# Operations (`Op`)

Every state change a driver can be asked to make. The values were range-checked by the catalog. There is no variant carrying a raw command, URL, path or payload, and there never will be.

`Driver::command(device, op)` receives one of these for one device, by its local id. Send it once and return `Ok(CommandAck)` as soon as the device has accepted it. The hub then reads the state back and decides whether it worked, by the rule under **Confirmed when**. Before any of that, `Plugin::refusal` has said whether this device takes this operation at all, in dry-run as well as live.

`Op` is `#[non_exhaustive]`: a `match` in a plugin ends with a `_` arm that refuses.

The JSON is the wire form: an object with the variant in `op`.

| Op | Class | Sent by | Read first | JSON |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`light_power`](#light_power) | light | `light.power`, `lights.power`, `scene.apply`, `room.power`, `room.scene`, `scene.movie` | no | `{"op":"light_power","on":true}` |
| [`light_brightness`](#light_brightness) | light | `light.brightness`, `lights.brightness`, `scene.apply`, `room.brightness`, `room.scene`, `scene.movie` | no | `{"op":"light_brightness","percent":40}` |
| [`light_hue`](#light_hue) | light | `light.hue` | no | `{"op":"light_hue","hue":210}` |
| [`light_set`](#light_set) | light | `scene.apply`, `room.scene`, `scene.movie` | no | `{"op":"light_set","percent":60,"hue":30}` |
| [`plug_power`](#plug_power) | plug | `plug.power` | no | `{"op":"plug_power","on":true}` |
| [`aircon_power`](#aircon_power) | aircon | `ac.power` | no | `{"op":"aircon_power","on":true}` |
| [`aircon_mode`](#aircon_mode) | aircon | `ac.mode` | no | `{"op":"aircon_mode","mode":"cool"}` |
| [`aircon_temp`](#aircon_temp) | aircon | `ac.temperature` | no | `{"op":"aircon_temp","celsius":22}` |
| [`aircon_fan`](#aircon_fan) | aircon | `ac.fan` | no | `{"op":"aircon_fan","fan":"auto"}` |
| [`volume`](#volume) | speaker | `speaker.volume` | no | `{"op":"volume","level":25}` |
| [`volume_cap`](#volume_cap) | speaker | `room.scene`, `scene.movie` | no | `{"op":"volume_cap","max":30}` |
| [`mute`](#mute) | speaker | `speaker.mute` | no | `{"op":"mute","muted":true}` |
| [`night_mode`](#night_mode) | speaker | `speaker.night` | no | `{"op":"night_mode","on":true}` |
| [`play`](#play) | speaker | `speaker.play` | no | `{"op":"play"}` |
| [`pause`](#pause) | speaker | `speaker.pause` | no | `{"op":"pause"}` |
| [`tv_power`](#tv_power) | tv | `room.scene`, `tv.power`, `scene.movie` | no | `{"op":"tv_power","on":true}` |
| [`tv_input`](#tv_input) | tv | `tv.input`, `room.scene`, `scene.movie` | no | `{"op":"tv_input","input":"HDMI 1"}` |
| [`tv_key`](#tv_key) | tv | `tv.key` | no | `{"op":"tv_key","key":"ok"}` |
| [`pet_feed`](#pet_feed) | feeder | `pets.feed` | yes | `{"op":"pet_feed","grams":10}` |
| [`litter_clean`](#litter_clean) | litter | `pets.clean` | yes | `{"op":"litter_clean"}` |
| [`print_start`](#print_start) | printer | `print.start` | no | `{"op":"print_start"}` |
| [`print_pause`](#print_pause) | printer | `print.pause` | no | `{"op":"print_pause"}` |
| [`print_resume`](#print_resume) | printer | `print.resume` | no | `{"op":"print_resume"}` |
| [`print_emergency_stop`](#print_emergency_stop) | printer | `print.estop` | no | `{"op":"print_emergency_stop"}` |
| [`vm_start`](#vm_start) | vm | `vm.start` | no | `{"op":"vm_start"}` |
| [`vm_shutdown`](#vm_shutdown) | vm | `vm.stop` | no | `{"op":"vm_shutdown"}` |
| [`vm_reboot`](#vm_reboot) | vm | `vm.restart` | yes | `{"op":"vm_reboot"}` |
| [`vm_force_stop`](#vm_force_stop) | vm | `vm.force_stop` | no | `{"op":"vm_force_stop"}` |
| [`host_shutdown`](#host_shutdown) | host | `host.shutdown` | no | `{"op":"host_shutdown"}` |
| [`host_reboot`](#host_reboot) | host | `host.reboot` | yes | `{"op":"host_reboot"}` |
| [`wireguard_restart`](#wireguard_restart) | router | `router.wireguard_restart` | yes | `{"op":"wireguard_restart"}` |
| [`custom`](#custom) | the action's class | a custom action | no | `{"op":"custom","action":"acme-blinds.calibrate","args":{"quiet":true,"speed":2}}` |

**Read first**: the hub reads the device's state before it sends the operation, because confirming it needs the value from before (a counter that must grow, an uptime that must drop). If that first read fails, nothing is sent.

## light_power

`Op::LightPower`. Turns one light on or off.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `on` | `bool` | On or off. |

```json
{"op":"light_power","on":true}
```

- Class: light
- Confirmed when: `light.on` equals `on`.

## light_brightness

`Op::LightBrightness`. Sets one light's brightness and turns it on. Zero turns it off where the light allows it.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `percent` | `u8` | Brightness in percent. |

```json
{"op":"light_brightness","percent":40}
```

- Class: light
- Confirmed when: The light is on and `bri` equals `percent` (a request under 10 is also met by 10, the lowest many lights go). `percent` 0 is also met by the light being off.

## light_hue

`Op::LightHue`. Sets one light's colour and turns it on.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hue` | `u16` | Colour as a hue angle in degrees, 0..=359. |

```json
{"op":"light_hue","hue":210}
```

- Class: light
- Confirmed when: The light is on, `color` is true and `hue` equals `hue`.

## light_set

`Op::LightSet`. Sets one light's brightness and colour at once. Zero brightness turns it off.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `percent` | `u8` | Brightness in percent. |
| `hue` | `u16` | Colour as a hue angle in degrees, 0..=359. |

```json
{"op":"light_set","percent":60,"hue":30}
```

- Class: light
- Confirmed when: The light is on, `color` is true, `bri` matches as for `light_brightness` and `hue` equals `hue`. `percent` 0 is also met by the light being off.

## tv_key

`Op::TvKey`. Presses one key on a TV's remote.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | `String` | One of the keys the TV accepts. |

```json
{"op":"tv_key","key":"ok"}
```

- Class: tv
- Confirmed when: Never: a key press leaves nothing to read back. The run ends `sent` once the TV accepts it.
- Note: nothing can show it worked (`cannot_be_read_back`)

## pet_feed

`Op::PetFeed`. Dispenses food from a feeder.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `grams` | `u8` | One of the portions the feeder accepts, in grams. |

```json
{"op":"pet_feed","grams":10}
```

- Class: feeder
- Confirmed when: `feeder.portions` is greater than before the command.
- Note: the hub reads the state first (`needs_baseline`)

## litter_clean

`Op::LitterClean`. Starts a litter box cleaning cycle.

```json
{"op":"litter_clean"}
```

- Class: litter
- Confirmed when: `litter.busy` is true, or `litter.cycles` is greater than before the command.
- Note: the hub reads the state first (`needs_baseline`)

## vm_shutdown

`Op::VmShutdown`. Shuts a VM down cleanly.


- Class: vm

## vm_reboot

`Op::VmReboot`. Reboots a VM.

```json
{"op":"vm_reboot"}
```

- Class: vm
- Confirmed when: `vm.state` is `"running"` and `vm.uptime_s` is lower than before the command.
- Note: the hub reads the state first (`needs_baseline`)

## vm_force_stop

`Op::VmForceStop`. Stops a VM at once, as pulling the plug would.

```json
{"op":"vm_force_stop"}
```

- Class: vm
- Confirmed when: `vm.state` is `"stopped"`.

## host_shutdown

`Op::HostShutdown`. Shuts a host down.

```json
{"op":"host_shutdown"}
```

- Class: host
- Confirmed when: `host.up` is false.
- Note: the device is expected to stop answering; an error while it goes is not a refusal (`takes_the_device_away`)

## host_reboot

`Op::HostReboot`. Reboots a host.

```json
{"op":"host_reboot"}
```

- Class: host
- Confirmed when: `host.up` is true and `host.uptime_s` is lower than before the command.
- Note: the hub reads the state first (`needs_baseline`); the device is expected to stop answering; an error while it goes is not a refusal (`takes_the_device_away`)

## wireguard_restart

`Op::WireguardRestart`. Restarts a router's VPN tunnel.

```json
{"op":"wireguard_restart"}
```

- Class: router
- Confirmed when: `router.wireguard_up` is true and `router.uptime_s` is lower than before the command.
- Note: the hub reads the state first (`needs_baseline`)

## custom

`Op::Custom`. An action the plugin declared in its manifest. `args` passed the declared parameter schema.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | `String` | The action's id, `<plugin id>.<verb>`. |
| `args` | `BTreeMap<String, Scalar>` | The arguments, by parameter name. |

```json
{"op":"custom","action":"acme-blinds.calibrate","args":{"quiet":true,"speed":2}}
```

- Class: the action's class
- Confirmed when: The action's `Expect`, from the manifest, holds on a `custom` state (see manifest.md).
